text:
maria: quick idea  what if gateway could emit a tiny speculative "preview" early (very short summary or checksum) + a verification token later so clients can show an instant preview and then confirm it when the full stream finishes. want to capture tradeoffs and an incremental plan.
dom: interesting. wire surface? NDJSON chunk with preview vs separate header?
maria: opt-in header + a single early chunk: header `X-RW-Preview: enabled=true`. first chunk could be `PREVIEW:{sha256:..., summary: "2-line"}`. later final chunk contains `VERIFY:{sha256:..., variant: "decoder-lite"}` so client can quickly show preview and then swap to final if checksum matches.
akshay: good for UX. concerns: 1) cache semantics 1: if preview served from cache but final came from updated model, mismatch risk; 2) attack surface: preview could leak content for sensitive data.
olivia: metrics: add span tags `preview.emitted` and `preview.mismatch_count`. sample alerts: spike in `preview.mismatch_rate` after deploy indicates stale cache or bug. Also sample preview only at 1% by default to limit cardinality.
maria: proposal: preview always marked with `preview_id` + `preview_ts`. final emits `verify_id` linking to preview. clients show preview immediately but treat it as tentative until verify matches. if mismatch, client should show revised content.
dom: retries: if gateway reroutes to fallback, increment attempt in verify_id (v123-2). Cache hits should set `preview_source=cache` and final `source=upstream` so client knows to expect possible mismatch.
akshay: admission/backpressure tie-in: previews should be very cheap (small summary) so they don't affect admission much. but we need to ensure previews aren't generated for every low-priority request to avoid work. sample policy: only preview for high-priority or opt-in routes, or sampled N%.
\emaria: security note: default off. require route-level opt-in; strip previews for private deployments unless explicitly enabled. redact summary by default for PII routes.
olivia: rollout: feature-flag `preview-v1`, prototype on chat-beta at 1% sampling, wire metrics and `preview.mismatch_rate` alert, SDK opt-in parsing and mapping. owners: @akshay gateway proto, @maria SDK docs + UX guide, @olivia metrics.
security-bot: reminder: preview payload must not include model internals or embeddings; add lint rule to block long previews.
maria: ok i'll write RFC follow-up with exact chunk format, TTLs for preview_id, and an example SDK snippet. thanks. :thumbsup:
